evidence.locator: Morning scene choice 115 option 0 -> section 119 -> node 365; reviewed commitment dialogue and Judy actor.

review.interpretation: The affirmative morning branch after intimacy expresses a continuing relationship. This writer is necessary but not sufficient: the rule also requires the terminal romance route.
review.participant: Judy is an actor in this exact scene; V makes the choice. No other spawned companion receives this private knowledge.

review.interpretation: Terminal historical completion, after the romance output and required objective input. The context records the choice made then, not an irrevocable present or future romance.

evidence.locator: Hut friendship branch: 52 -> AND 62 -> journal success 76 -> cleanup 273/278/274/268 -> reward 113 -> exact friendship assignment 171.

review.interpretation: An affirmative terminal friendship result. It is not inferred by zero romance, ineligibility, missing facts, or quest completion alone.

evidence.locator: Normal oilfield entry 91 reaches choice 624; option 0 -> dialogue section 626 -> quest node 1483 increments sq032_johnny_friend by 1.

review.interpretation: V gives Johnny one final chance and Johnny answers with a commitment to try. The adjacent alternative routes elsewhere. The fact is an increment, not an exact set or a percentage.
review.participant: Johnny is the Silverhand scene actor and speaks in the same section. Rogue and other companions do not gain knowledge from this mapping.

evidence.locator: Metajournal inner node 36 checks sq032_johnny_friend GreaterOrEqual 1.

rules.statement: After the dive at Laguna Bend, V and Judy chose to continue their relationship.
Judy and V finished their Laguna Bend visit as friends.
At the oilfield, V gave Johnny a final chance to rebuild their relationship, and Johnny committed to trying.
